description: The straight stair designed for 1800 mm of headroom. The floor above has its bottom at 2400 mm, 3072000, as L1's ceilings have, so a step needs it open when the top of the riser after it is above 600 mm, 768000 - the lanes over a step rise to that top: the second tread's next riser tops out at 740571.43, and the third's at 987428.57 - the opening starts at the third step, index 2, and every step after it needs it too. Its headroom, 2331428.57 - about 1821 mm - is more than it declares, so there is no FS-LINT-019.
